original_request: <<paste exactly what you would type, e.g. 'תכתוב לי דף נחיתה לתוכנית של האמהות'>>
brief: <<what the page must achieve — one sentence>>
audience: <<who: age, situation, what they have already tried, what they are afraid of>>
brand_voice: <<register and tone, e.g. 'warm, direct, no hype, speaks to them as adults'>>
approved_facts: <<a fact you have confirmed, e.g. 'groups are capped at eight'>>
<<price, if it may be stated at all>>
desired_output: <<e.g. 'headline, subheadline, three benefit blocks, one CTA'>>
success_criteria: <<e.g. 'a reader who has not trained in ten years feels it is for them'>>
expected: <<describe what a good answer looks like, for your own reading>>
must_not_contain: <<any price that is not in approved_facts>>
notes: Competition mode is worth it here. A landing page is expensive to get wrong.
